Name: Capture
Author: Reza Behjat

Actions.Name: Capture Command
Actions.Tooltip: Fires any Capture menu command (View, Edit, File…). Dims when the command is disabled. (Hidden in v0.3: only kept so keys placed earlier still work.)

Actions.Name: Capture Tab
Actions.Tooltip: Switches Capture to Design, Fixtures, Universes, Media, Snapshots or Library. (Hidden in v0.3: only kept so keys placed earlier still work.)

Actions.Name: Camera Slot
Actions.Tooltip: Recalls Camera Position 1–5. While a Store Modifier key is held, stores it instead. (Hidden in v0.3: only kept so keys placed earlier still work.)

Actions.Name: Camera: Store Modifier
Actions.Tooltip: Hold this key, then press Camera: Position 1–5 to store the camera in that slot instead of recalling it.

Actions.Name: Show Position
Actions.Tooltip: Recalls a camera position from the open show over OSC, titled with its name in Capture. (Hidden in v0.3: only kept so keys placed earlier still work.)

Actions.Name: View Dial
Actions.Tooltip: Turn to adjust a Capture view setting over OSC. Push or touch: fine mode. Long touch: reset. (Hidden in v0.3: only kept so keys placed earlier still work.)

Actions.Name: View Toggle
Actions.Tooltip: Toggles Auto Exposure or Laser Flicker Effect over OSC. (Hidden in v0.3: only kept so keys placed earlier still work.)

Actions.Name: Status: Connection
Actions.Tooltip: Shows whether Capture answers over OSC, its version, and whether Accessibility access is OK. Press to re-check.

Description: An interface to Capture: keys fire Capture's own menu commands and tabs and recall camera positions; dials adjust view settings over OSC. Every action is a straight command, and a ready-made Stream Deck+ profile organises them in folders.
